correctness.rationale: Full definition and uniform invariant probability fixed; independent Bernoulli base digits give a Markov center kernel. Exact dilated-sawtooth Koopman equations and inner products prove the algebraic GF coefficientwise. Formal-root physical sheet, pole residues, both square-root branch points and collision singularities yield all asymptotics including parity. Exact-rational 29-term cross-checks and direct original-map Monte Carlo agree; computations only corroborate the infinite proof.
